# Tutorials

Each tutorial is a documentation page with prose, code, and an embedded **playground** where you run
the state machine in the browser: pick a **Sender** and **Message**, edit payload fields, **Send**, and
read the live **Trace**. **Reset** rebuilds the machine from its initial configuration.

All tutorials are verified by Mocha specs:

```bash
npm run test:tutorials
# or: nix flake check
```

| # | Tutorial | Focus |
|---|----------|-------|

| 02 | [Tracing](/tutorials/02-tracing) | trace writer, verbose log |

| 05 | [Hierarchy](/tutorials/05-hierarchy) | entry/exit, LCA transitions |
| 07 | [Internal transitions](/tutorials/07-internal-transitions) | handlers without `transition()` |
| 08 | [post and sync](/tutorials/08-post-and-sync) | queued events |
| 09 | [deferredPost](/tutorials/09-deferred-post) | timers |
| 10 | [call services](/tutorials/10-call-services) | sync/async services |
| 11 | [restore](/tutorials/11-restore) | hydrate snapshots |
